evidence.decision: Decides reading versus editing separately from selection/copy, and selects text view versus label or short-entry field by content purpose.
evidence.artifact: Requires edited view or annotated reading/editing specification with sizing, scrolling, copy and editability behavior.
evidence.transformation: Diagnostic report example replaces clipped unselectable labels with read-only multiline reflow and copying of actual-text identifiers.
evidence.verification: Tests long paragraphs, unbroken identifiers, enlarged text, multiline selection and saved input; fails clipped required content and unintended edits.
evidence.applicability: Retains Dynamic Type/Bold Text, relevant iOS/iPadOS keyboards and tvOS display-only text views; identifies native execution as unknown.
evidence.handoffs: Loads text-fields for short input, labels for captions and typography only when hierarchy requires deeper work.
evidence.distinctiveness: Separating read-only from unselectable and defining text ownership, reflow and copy semantics provide text-view-specific operating decisions.
